https://www.myjoyonline.com/malawi-deleg.body: Malawi is looking to Ghana’s experience in gold production and mining-sector reforms for lessons to strengthen its own mineral governance, with a focus on responsible sourcing, artisanal mining and the financing of mineral-related businesses. The delegation, led by Malawi’s Minister of Mining, Thoko Tembo, met Ghana’s Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, as part of a learning mission supported by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). The engagement focused on Ghana’s mining governance framework and ongoing efforts to improve gold purchasing, traceability, production accounting and the management of mineral revenues. Mr Buah said Ghana’s long history of mining had provided experience from which other countries could learn, while emphasising that the country was also working to improve its policies and regulatory systems. He said ongoing reforms were intended to strengthen accountability in the gold sector, protect the environment and ensure mining communities had a greater voice and benefited from resources extracted from their lands. The Lands Minister outlined proposed changes to the mining licensing regime, including clearer timelines and performance requirements for companies holding mining rights. He also highlighted plans to involve district-level mining committees in assessing proposed concessions before licences are issued. The proposed measures are intended to strengthen oversight and improve the assessment of mining proposals before they receive regulatory approval. Chief Executive Officer of the Minerals Commission, Isaac Tandoh, also presented Ghana’s mining governance framework to the delegation. He responded to questions on domestic gold purchasing, the formalisation of mineral markets and efforts to strengthen responsible sourcing systems. Malawi’s Minister of Mining, Thoko Tembo, welcomed the opportunity to learn from Ghana’s experience, including challenges encountered in developing and regulating its mining industry. He said the delegation wanted practical lessons that could help Malawi avoid similar difficulties as it develops its own sector. The discussions included artisanal and small-scale mining and access to financing for businesses operating in the minerals industry. The delegation also included representatives of Malawi’s banking sector and artisanal and small-scale mining industry, reflecting an interest in both regulatory approaches and the financial systems needed to support mineral-sector development. The engagement provided an opportunity for the two countries to exchange perspectives on mining regulation, domestic mineral markets and responsible sourcing. For Ghana, the discussions come as authorities pursue reforms aimed at improving accountability in gold purchasing and strengthening oversight of mining activities. For Malawi, the visit offers an opportunity to examine Ghana’s policy approaches and consider which lessons could inform the development of its own mining industry
https://www.myjoyonline.com/malawi-deleg.title_zh: 马拉维代表团考察加纳矿业改革及负责任的黄金治理
https://www.myjoyonline.com/malawi-deleg.body_zh: 马拉维正借鉴加纳在黄金生产和矿业部门改革方面的经验，以加强自身矿产治理，重点关注负责任采购、手工采矿以及矿产相关企业的融资。由马拉维矿业部长托科·腾博率领的代表团会见了加纳土地与自然资源部长埃马纽埃尔·阿马-科菲·布阿。此次学习访问得到联合国开发计划署（UNDP）支持。交流重点围绕加纳的矿业治理框架，以及加纳正在推进的黄金收购、可追溯性、生产核算和矿产收入管理改进工作。布阿表示，加纳悠久的采矿历史积累了可供其他国家借鉴的经验，同时强调加纳也在努力完善政策和监管体系。他说，持续推进的改革旨在加强黄金行业问责、保护环境，并确保采矿社区拥有更大发言权，且能从其土地上开采的资源中获得更多利益。土地部长介绍了拟对矿业许可制度作出的调整，包括为持有采矿权的公司设定更明确的时间要求和绩效要求。他还强调，计划在颁发许可证之前，让地区级矿业委员会参与评估拟议的采矿特许权。这些拟议措施旨在加强监督，并改善对矿业项目在获得监管批准前的评估。矿产委员会首席执行官艾萨克·坦多赫也向代表团介绍了加纳的矿业治理框架，并就国内黄金收购、矿产市场正规化以及加强负责任采购体系的努力回答了问题。马拉维矿业部长托科·腾博对有机会借鉴加纳经验表示欢迎，其中包括开发和监管本国矿业过程中所遇到的挑战。他说，代表团希望获得切实可行的经验，以帮助马拉维在发展本国矿业时避免类似困难。讨论内容涵盖手工采矿和小规模采矿，以及矿产行业企业获得融资的问题。代表团成员还包括马拉维银行业以及手工采矿和小规模采矿行业的代表，反映出双方既关注监管方法，也关注支持矿产行业发展的金融体系。此次交流为两国提供了就矿业监管、国内矿产市场和负责任采购交换观点的机会。对加纳而言，相关讨论正值当局推进旨在提高黄金收购问责和加强对采矿活动监督的改革之际。对马拉维而言，此次访问提供了一个考察加纳政策做法，并思考哪些经验可以为本国矿业发展提供借鉴的机会

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: A prosecution witness, on Monday, told the Federal High Court in Abuja that the University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN), and the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) disowned certificates linked to former Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Geoffrey Nnaji. The witness, who identified himself as Yakubu Ibrahim, a superintendent of police officer with the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC), made the revelation. He was led in evidence by prosecution lawyer J.A Mumini, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN). ICPC is prosecuting Mr Nnaji on certificate forgery and money laundering charges. An investigation by PREMIUM TIMES exposed the certificate forgery scandal leading to Mr Nnaji’s ouster from office last year. The former minister is the Peoples Democratic Party’s governorship candidate for the upcoming 2027 governorship candidate in Enugu State. Mr Ibrahim said his team was assigned to investigate the matter after the commission received two separate petitions alleging certificate forgery against Mr Nnaji. He said the Chairman of the Special Task Force directed an investigation, prompting the commission to request relevant documents from the National Assembly, the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation (SGF), University of Nigeria, Nsukka and the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC). According to him, the Clerk of the Senate, National Assembly, forwarded Mr Nnaji’s NYSC certificate and BSc certificate in Microbiology and Biochemistry to the commission. He said NYSC responded that the certificate purportedly issued by the corps was not issued by it. The witness further told the court that UNN also responded that Nnaji failed to obtain the required grades for the award of his certificate. He said the university explained in its letter the policy governing the grades required for the award of a certificate saying if one failed four times, the person was not qualified. Mr Ibrahim said Mr Nnaji failed at two stages and did not write the examination at the third stage for medical reasons. “The witness said that, according to the letter, the defendant went ahead to write the supplementary examination for which he did not register,” he said. Mr Ibrahim further testified that UNN confirmed that the BSc certificate in Microbiology and Biochemistry attributed to the defendant was not issued by the university. He said the commission also obtained documents from the SGF’s office, including a payslip, which prompted it to request Mr Nnaji’s bank statement. According to him, the bank statement showed that Mr Nnaji received N29.5 million in salary as minister before he resigned . The witness identified letters sent to the Clerk of the Senate, the SGF, UNN, NYSC, the bank and Mr Nnaji, which were tendered in evidence. He also told the court that Mr Nnaji failed to honour the commission’s invitation to answer questions on the petitions, prompting the ICPC to contact the State Security Service (SSS). Mr Nnaji’s lawyer, Wole Olanipekun, a SAN, said he would reserve his objection to the admissibility of the documents until the appropriate stage of the proceedings, if necessary. In a ruling, Judge Joyce Abdulmalik admitted the documents in evidence but held that objections to their admissibility would be reserved until the final address. During cross-examination by Mr Olanipekun, Mr Ibrahim told the court that he did not visit UNN during his investigation. He also said he did not know how many campuses the university had or the faculty from which Mr Nnaji graduated. Asked whether he interviewed any past or present university staff member, the witness said he interviewed a registrar named Ngozi but could not recall her surname. Mr Ibrahim also told the court that he saw a letter from UNN directing the withdrawal of Mr Nnaji’s admission. Mr Olanipekun, however, drew his attention to another letter showing that the withdrawal letter dated 7 November 1984, was rescinded by a subsequent letter dated 18 March 1985. With no further questions from the defence for the witness, the prosecution requested an adjournment to enable it call another witness. Ms Abdulmalik adjourned the matter until 5 November for continuation of trial. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Nnaji was arraigned before the Federal High Court on six counts of certificate forgery, money laundering and abuse of office. The ICPC, which filed the charges, alleged that Mr Nnaji presented forged UNN degree and NYSC certificates to support his ministerial appointment in 2023. The commission also accused him of receiving about N29.58 million in salaries and allowances as minister, allegedly linked to proceeds of unlawful acts. The court granted him bail in yhe sum of N20 million with one surety and he was ordered to deposit his passport with the court. He is not to travel outside the country without permission from the court throughout the period of his trial
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 涉嫌伪造证书：证人在法庭上称UNN和NYSC否认Nnaji的证书
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 周一，一名控方证人在阿布贾联邦高等法院表示，尼日利亚大学恩苏卡分校（UNN）和国家青年服务团（NYSC）均否认签发与前创新、科技部长Geoffrey Nnaji有关联的证书。自称尼日利亚独立腐败预防及其他相关罪行委员会（ICPC）警监Yakubu Ibrahim的证人披露了此事。控方律师、尼日利亚资深大律师（J.A Mumini）引导他作证。ICPC正以伪造证书和洗钱罪名起诉Nnaji先生。PREMIUM TIMES的调查揭露了这起伪造证书丑闻，导致Nnaji先生去年被免职。这位前部长是人民民主党在埃努古州即将举行的2027年州长选举中的候选人。Ibrahim先生表示，委员会收到两份分别指控Nnaji先生伪造证书的申诉后，指派其团队调查此事。他说，特别任务组主席指示展开调查，促使委员会向国家议会、联邦政府秘书办公室（SGF）、尼日利亚大学恩苏卡分校和国家青年服务团（NYSC）索取相关文件。据他介绍，国家议会参议院书记官转交给委员会Nnaji先生的国家青年服务团证书以及微生物学和生物化学理学士学位证书。他说，NYSC回复称，声称由该团签发的证书并非其签发。证人进一步告诉法庭，UNN也回复称，Nnaji未达到获颁证书所需的成绩。他说，学校在信函中解释了取得证书所适用的成绩政策：若有4次不及格，该人士便不具备资格。Ibrahim先生说，Nnaji先生在两个阶段未能通过考试，并因医疗原因没有参加第三个阶段的考试。他说：“证人表示，根据信函，被告仍参加了补考，尽管他并未为补考报名。”Ibrahim先生进一步作证称，UNN确认 attributed to the defendant 的微生物学和生物化学理学士学位证书并非由该大学签发。他说，委员会还从SGF办公室取得了包括工资单在内的文件，并据此要求提供Nnaji先生的银行账单。据他介绍，银行账单显示，Nnaji先生担任部长期间收取了29.5 million naira薪金，之后辞职。证人确认了发给参议院书记官、SGF、UNN、NYSC、银行及Nnaji先生的信函，并将其作为证据提交。他还告诉法庭，Nnaji先生未按委员会要求接受询问、就申诉回答问题，促使ICPC联系了国家安全局（SSS）。Nnaji先生的律师、尼日利亚资深大律师Wole Olanipekun表示，如有必要，他将在诉讼程序的适当阶段再对这些文件能否采纳提出异议。法官Joyce Abdulmalik裁定准许将这些文件作为证据，但表示关于其可采性的异议将留待最终陈词阶段处理。在Olanipekun先生交叉询问期间，Ibrahim先生告诉法庭，他在调查期间没有前往UNN。他还说，自己不知道该校有多少个校区，也不知道Nnaji先生毕业于哪个学院。问他是否询问过该大学任何过去或现任工作人员，证人说，他询问过一名名为Ngozi的注册主任，但无法想起她的姓氏。Ibrahim先生还告诉法庭，他看到了一封来自UNN、要求撤销Nnaji先生入学资格的信函。然而，Olanipekun先生提请他注意另一封信，该信显示，日期为1984年11月7日的撤销入学信函已被日期为1985年3月18日的后续信函撤销。辩方没有再向该证人提问后，控方请求休庭，以便传唤另一名证人。Abdulmalik女士将案件延期至11月5日继续审理。尼日利亚通讯社（NAN）报道称，Nnaji因6项伪造证书、洗钱和滥用职权罪名被带到联邦高等法院受审。提出指控的ICPC称，Nnaji先生提交了伪造的UNN学位证书和NYSC证书，以支持其于2023年获任部长。委员会还指控他担任部长期间收取约29.58 million naira的薪金和津贴，称这些款项涉嫌与非法所得有关。法院准许其以20 million naira保释，条件是提供一名担保人，并命令他将护照交由法院保管。在整个审判期间，未经法院许可，他不得离开该国。

https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.title: 2027 elections: 103m voters, 35m votes and the 68% who may decide the presidency
https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.summary: The electorate is bigger than ever and the field more fragmented, but the outcome may turn less on what voters think than on which of them actually vote. Hold preferences constant – Tinubu voters stay with Tinubu, Atiku’s with Atiku, Obi’s with Obi and Kwankwaso’s with Kwankwaso – and change only turnout. Apply the 2023 national turnout of 26.71% uniformly to the new register and the arithmetic gives Mr Tinubu 9.60m votes, an Obi–Kwankwaso ticket 8.97m and Mr Atiku 7.23m.
https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.summary_zh: 选民人数比以往任何时候都多，阵营也更加分散，但最终结果与其说取决于选民怎么想，不如说取决于他们实际上谁会投票。假设选民偏好保持不变——廷努布的支持者继续支持廷努布，阿提库的继续支持阿提库，奥比的继续支持奥比，夸恩克瓦索的继续支持夸恩克瓦索——仅改变投票率。将2023年全国投票率26.71%统一套用于新选民名册，计算结果显示，廷努布先生获得960万票，奥比—夸恩克瓦索组合获得897万票，阿提库先生获得723万票。
https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.body: If Nigerians vote as they did in 2023 but more of them turn up, the race for Aso Rock looks very different. Turnout in the South-East, Kano’s Kwankwaso machine, four state reversals and a regional upstart may matter more than any change of heart. Nigerians will choose a president in fewer than 100 days, most of them preoccupied with insecurity and the soaring cost of living. Yet the election holds a paradox. The electorate is bigger than ever and the field more fragmented, but the outcome may turn less on what voters think than on which of them actually vote. Start with the numbers. The register has swollen to 103.4m, from 93.5m in 2023. State-by-state results from the last election, compiled by Vanguard and Stears , supply the map. Hold preferences constant – Tinubu voters stay with Tinubu, Atiku’s with Atiku, Obi’s with Obi and Kwankwaso’s with Kwankwaso – and change only turnout. The map starts to misbehave. A caveat: this is a scenario, not a forecast or a poll. It combines the 2026-27 register with 2023 state-level vote shares, then layers on assumptions – constructed turnout rates, an Obi–Kwankwaso merger, swapped vote shares in Plateau, Osun, Taraba and Bayelsa, and a hypothetical Makinde–Bala ticket on the APM platform in Bauchi and Oyo. Later sections test direct switches between Mr Tinubu and Mr Atiku. Nor does the model adjust for rigging. It does not need to: the 2023 results were challenged all the way to the Supreme Court on grounds of irregularities and upheld. Whatever irregularities occurred are therefore already built into the legally settled baseline on which these projections rest. In 2023 Mr Peter Obi ran up huge margins in parts of the South, but many of his strongholds turned out only modestly. Mr Bola Tinubu and Mr Abubakar Atiku, by contrast, drew heavily on high-turnout states. Apply the 2023 national turnout of 26.71% uniformly to the new register and the arithmetic gives Mr Tinubu 9.60m votes, an Obi–Kwankwaso ticket 8.97m and Mr Atiku 7.23m. The merger alone transforms the race. The more interesting question is what happens if low-turnout areas start behaving like high-turnout ones. Take Anambra and Kano. Suppose Anambra’s voters, instead of repeating their lacklustre 2023 showing, turned out at roughly Kano’s rate. Extend that across Mr Obi’s 2023 winning states: a turnout floor of 31.7%, with higher historical rates kept wherever they already exceeded it. The result flips. Obi–Kwankwaso edges ahead with 10.14m votes to Mr Tinubu’s 10.06m, with Mr Atiku on 7.51m – a margin of barely 85,000. That should unsettle every party headquarters. Mr Obi may not need to win in 2027 over millions of 2023 Tinubu voters; he may first need to get more of his own sympathisers to the polls. Two can play that game. Give Mr Atiku’s states the same treatment, however, and the advantage evaporates. Higher turnout in Adamawa, Bauchi, Gombe, Kaduna, Katsina, Kebbi, Osun, Sokoto, Taraba, Yobe and the rest of his territory does not help him alone, because his rivals also polled heavily there. Mr Tinubu returns to the lead with about 11.05m votes, against 10.50m for Obi–Kwankwaso and 8.83m for Mr Atiku. Do the same for Mr Tinubu’s states and turnout climbs towards 34.7m, roughly 33.6% of the register: Mr Tinubu 12.16m, Obi–Kwankwaso 10.79m, Mr Atiku 9.51m. The incumbent’s structural advantage reasserts itself. The lesson: mobilisation cannot be judged in isolation. If everyone gets out the vote equally well, the advantage returns to the coalition with the best mix of geographical spread, big-state strength and respectable second places. Elections are not reruns, so introduce some movement. Suppose Plateau, which Mr Obi won in 2023, swings to Mr Tinubu; rather than invent a swing, simply swap the two men’s 2023 vote shares. Do the same for three of Mr Atiku’s states – Osun, Taraba and Bayelsa – drifting towards Mr Tinubu. Mr Tinubu rises to about 12.48m; Obi–Kwankwaso slips to 10.62m and Mr Atiku to 9.35m. His lead stretches to some 1.86m. Four states have changed the complexion of the race. Enter the spoiler. Now add a Makinde–Bala ticket on the APM platform that concentrates on just two states: Bauchi, Mr Atiku’s in 2023, and Oyo, Mr Tinubu’s. In each, the previous winner is demoted to runner-up and the newcomer takes the winning share. That gives the APM about 584,000 votes in Bauchi and 601,000 in Oyo – some 1.18m from two states alone. A four-way race. Under the full scenario, turnout reaches about 35m. Mr Tinubu wins 11.69m votes (33.67%), Obi–Kwankwaso 10.62m (30.58%), Mr Atiku 8.96m (25.79%) and Makinde–Bala 1.18m (3.41%); other candidates share the remaining 2.2m (6.55%). Mr Tinubu still leads, but by only a little more than one million. Note what did not happen. Nobody conjured an electoral revolution. The exercise merely enlarged the electorate, nudged turnout, merged two camps, moved four states and added a regional challenger. Yet the lead changed hands, and the winning margin ranged from 85,000 to 1.86m. Much hinges on turnout, nowhere more than in the South-East, whose five states hold about 11.98m registered voters. But registration confers no clout by itself: a voter who stays at home counts for exactly as much as one who never registered. Turnout may be the great hidden variable of 2027. Lagos has nearly 7.5m registered voters. At 31.7% turnout that means almost 2.4m ballots. On 2023 shares, Obi–Kwankwaso takes about 1.05m to Mr Tinubu’s 1.02m – a statistical dead heat. A shift of a few tens of thousands could tip the national result. Lagos is worth not merely winning, but winning well. The art of losing well. Perhaps the least intuitive lesson is that the presidential race is not 37 winner-takes-all contests. A candidate who loses a state 45 to 40 still banks his 40. Winning more states is a different strategy from maximising the national vote while keeping enough geographical spread. Kingmakers, not kings. With 1.18m votes, Makinde–Bala is nowhere near first place. Yet its effect could be outsized, because it does not draw votes evenly: in Bauchi it hurts mainly Mr Atiku, in Oyo mainly Mr Tinubu. A small fourth candidate concentrated in the right states can wield influence out of all proportion to its national share. Whoever comes fourth could help decide who comes first. The model boils the election down to four linked contests. The first is over turnout: can low-participation strongholds vote in greater numbers without their rivals doing the same? The second is over coalitions: Obi–Kwankwaso looks formidable because it pairs strength in the South-East, the Middle Belt and Lagos with Mr Kwankwaso’s following in Kano. The third concerns defecting states: Plateau, Osun, Taraba and Bayelsa show how a handful of plausible shifts can move hundreds of thousands of net votes. The fourth is the spoiler contest, in which a Makinde–Bala-style ticket matters without ever being nationally competitive. A frightening number. Mr Tinubu’s final lead of a little more than one million is roughly 1% of a register of more than 103m. With only about a third of registered voters turning out, modest changes among today’s non-voters could easily swamp it. Keep the swaps and turnout alone cannot do it. The break-even rate against Mr Tinubu rises to about 121% – a mathematical impossibility. Even at 100% turnout in all 12 states, Mr Tinubu polls 18.02m to Mr Atiku’s 17.37m, a lead of some 656,000.Why is the bar so high? First, extra turnout is shared: with 2023 shares fixed, Mr Tinubu and Obi–Kwankwaso also gain, notably in Katsina, Kebbi, Sokoto, Osun and Bauchi, where Mr Tinubu was a competitive runner-up. Second, with the APM taking the winning share in Bauchi, a higher turnout there helps Makinde–Bala more than it does Mr Atiku. Third, in Bayelsa, Osun and Taraba, Mr Tinubu now holds the larger share, so every extra voter there widens his lead. At 1m switches, Mr Tinubu and Obi–Kwankwaso are separated by about 75,000 votes, with Mr Atiku still third. Only at around 2m does he move clear, leading Obi–Kwankwaso by about 339,000 and Mr Tinubu by about 1.26m. The crucial word is net. Every southern Atiku voter who drifts to Mr Tinubu adds one to the northern requirement: lose 500,000 in the South, and he needs about 2.16m converts (38.6% of Mr Tinubu’s 2023 northern vote); lose 1m, and he needs 2.66m (47.5%). Even with no southern losses, a comfortable 500,000-vote victory would take about 2.16m switches. It is tempting to split Nigeria into a northern Atiku constituency and a southern Tinubu one. The arithmetic is messier. In 2023 Mr Tinubu led Mr Atiku across the 19 northern states and the FCT by only about 365,000 votes, against roughly 1.46m in the South. Split the North further, and the picture sharpens. Across the North-West and North-East – the Core North – Mr Atiku actually won, by about 234,000. That conceals two contests: Mr Tinubu took the North-West by some 323,000, Mr Atiku the North-East by about 556,000. In other words, “Atiku takes the North, Tinubu takes the South” largely happened in 2023. Mr Atiku’s problem was scale: Mr Tinubu’s southern margin was more than six times his Core North advantage. Between the two blocs sits the North-Central, which should not be treated as an appendage of the Core North. In 2023 it split three ways: Mr Tinubu won about 1.76m votes, Mr Obi and Mr Kwankwaso together about 1.48m and Mr Atiku about 1.16m. Mr Tinubu carried Benue, Kogi, Kwara and Niger; Mr Obi took Nasarawa, Plateau and the FCT. With APC-leaning territory, old PDP constituencies, strong Obi support and ethnically and religiously mixed electorates, it is a genuine swing belt. A 10% transfer of Mr Tinubu’s North-Central vote to Mr Atiku would move about 176,000 votes and swing their head-to-head margin by about 352,000 – meaningful, but not decisive alone. Its leverage lies in amplifying a Core North recovery or protecting a southern lead. Now strip out the turnout boosts, swaps and spoiler and return to the plain baseline: 26.71% turnout applied to each state’s share of the 103.4m register, with 2023 vote shares held state by state. About 27.6m votes are cast across three theatres. The 2023 pattern survives, but its scale changes. Mr Atiku’s Core North lead shrinks to about 132,000, while Mr Tinubu’s southern lead swells to almost 1.9m – more than fourteen times as large. And the North-Central is far from neutral: it hands Mr Tinubu a further 610,000. Before a single southern vote is counted, he is about 479,000 ahead across the North and the FCT. Now test a reciprocal realignment: a share of Mr Tinubu’s Core North voters switches to Mr Atiku, while the same share of Mr Atiku’s southern voters switches to Mr Tinubu, with the North-Central unchanged. Equal percentages are not equal numbers. Mr Tinubu’s Core North pool (3.88m) is nearly twice Mr Atiku’s southern one (2.10m), so at 10% about 388,000 northern voters move to Mr Atiku and only about 210,000 southern voters to Mr Tinubu. The paradox is that both men grow stronger, in different halves of the country. At 15%, Mr Atiku leads the Core North by almost 1.3m, yet Mr Tinubu leads the South by about 2.52m and the country by about 1.84m. Drawing from the larger pool, Mr Atiku closes the gap, but slowly: across the two blocs, break-even comes at about 49.4% – nearly half of Mr Tinubu’s Core North support defecting while the same share of Mr Atiku’s southern vote goes the other way. That is not a swing but a realignment, and it would still leave Mr Tinubu’s 610,000 North-Central cushion intact. A northern recovery is therefore necessary for Mr Atiku but not sufficient: he must also stop the PDP’s residual southern vote in Rivers, Oyo, Ogun, Akwa Ibom and beyond from shrinking. That makes the North-West arguably the decisive battlefield. Mr Atiku already beat Mr Tinubu in the North-East; the bigger, harder prize lies in Kano, Kaduna, Katsina, Jigawa, Kebbi, Sokoto and Zamfara.

1079万票，Atiku先生951万票。执政者的结构性优势再次显现。教训在于：不能孤立地评估动员效果。如果所有人都能以同等程度参与投票，优势就会回到那个在地域覆盖、大州实力和体面的第二名成绩方面拥有最佳组合的联盟。选举并非简单重演，因此再加入一些选情变动。假设Obi先生2023年获胜的Plateau转向Tinubu先生；不凭空设定转投幅度，只互换两人的2023年得票率。对Atiku先生的3个州——Osun、Taraba和Bayelsa——也作同样处理，让它们向Tinubu先生偏移。Tinubu先生升至约1248万票，Obi—Kwankwaso降至1062万票，Atiku先生降至935万票。他的领先优势扩大到约186万票。4个州改变了整场选情的面貌。接下来是搅局者。再加入Makinde—Bala以APM平台参选，重点只在两个州布局：Bauchi，即Atiku先生2023年获胜的州，以及Oyo，即Tinubu先生的州。在这两个州，原胜者都降至第二，新入场者取得胜者份额。这使APM在Bauchi获得约58.4万票，在Oyo获得约60.1万票——仅凭两个州便获得约118万票。这变成了一场四方角逐。在完整情景下，投票总数达到约3500万票。Tinubu先生以1169万票获胜（33.67%），Obi—Kwankwaso获1062万票（30.58%），Atiku先生获896万票（25.79%），Makinde—Bala获118万票（3.41%）；其他候选人分得剩余的220万票（6.55%）。Tinubu先生仍然领先，但优势只略高于100万票。注意没有发生什么。没有人变出了一场选举革命。这项推演只是扩大了选民群体，略微推高了投票率，合并了两个阵营，移动了4个州，并增加了一名地区挑战者。然而，领先优势却易主，获胜差距也从8.5万票到186万票不等。很大程度上取决于投票率，东南部尤其如此。该地区5个州拥有约1198万名登记选民。但登记本身并不赋予任何影响力：待在家里的选民，与从未登记的选民影响完全相同。投票率可能才是2027年最关键的隐藏变量。Lagoos拥有近750万名登记选民。若投票率为31.7%，就意味着将投出近240万张选票。按2023年的得票率计算，Obi—Kwankwaso获得约105万票，Tinubu先生获得约102万票—— statistically两 statistically几乎持平。几万张选票的转移，就可能改变全国结果。Lagoos值得争取的不仅是胜利，而且是大幅获胜。这是如何输得漂亮的一门艺术。或许最反直觉的教训是，总统竞选并不是37场赢者通吃的竞争。一个候选人即使在某个州以45%对40%落败，仍能保留那40%的选票。赢得更多州，与在保持足够地域分布的同时把全国得票最大化，是两种不同的策略。造王者，而非王中之王。Makinde—Bala凭118万票远非位居第一，但其影响可能远超选票本身，因为这些选票并非平均分散：在Bauchi，它主要打击Atiku先生；在Oyo，它主要打击Tinubu先生。一名聚焦于恰到好处州份的小型第四候选人，能够施加与其全国份额远不相称的影响。最终位居第四的人，可能帮助决定谁位居第一。这个模型把选举归结为4场相互关联的较量。第一场围绕投票率：低参与率票仓能否在不引发对手同样增加投票的情况下投出更多选票？第二场围绕联盟：Obi—Kwankwaso之所以看似强大，是因为它把东南部、中部地带和Lagos的实力，与Kwankwaso先生在Kano的追随者结合起来。第三场涉及倒戈的州：Plateau、Osun、Taraba和Bayelsa表明，少量看似合理的选情转移，就可能净移动数十万张选票。第四场是搅局者之争，Makinde—Bala式组合虽在全国层面毫无竞争力，却能产生关键影响。这个数字令人不寒而栗。Tinubu先生最终略高于100万票的领先优势，只相当于1亿多选民名册的约1%。在登记选民中仅有约三分之一出来投票的情况下，如今不投票者中哪怕比例不高的人改变选择，也很容易淹没这点优势。仅靠互换选票和投票率变化无法做到这一点。令Tinubu先生无法被追平的临界比率会升至约121%——在数学上不可能实现。即使12个州的投票率都达到100%，Tinubu先生仍会以1802万票领先Atiku先生的1737万票，优势约65.6万票。为什么门槛如此之高？第一，新增投票是共享的：在2023年得票率固定不变的情况下，Tinubu先生和Obi—Kwankwaso也会增加得票，尤其是在Katsina、Kebbi、Sokoto、Osun和Bauchi，Tinubu先生在那里是颇具竞争力的第二名。第二，在APM于Bauchi取得胜者份额后，当地投票率越高，对Makinde—Bala的帮助就大于对Atiku先生的帮助。第三，在Bayelsa、Osun和Taraba，Tinubu先生如今拥有更大得票率，因此当地每多一名投票者，都会扩大他的领先优势。在发生100万张选票转移时，Tinubu先生与Obi—Kwankwaso之间的差距约为7.5万票，Atiku先生仍居第三。只有转移规模达到约200万票，他才能明确领先，届时领先Obi—Kwankwaso约33.9万票，领先Tinubu先生约126万票。关键在于“净”字。每一名从南部转投Tinubu先生的Atiku选民，都会使北部的追赶要求增加一人：若在南部失去50万票，他就需要约216万张选票完成转换，相当于Tinubu先生2023年北部选票的38.6%；若失去100万票，就需要266万张（47.5%）。即使没有南部失票，要取得一场稳稳当当的50万票胜利，也需要约216万张选票发生转换。把尼日利亚划分为北部的Atiku选区和南部的Tinubu选区颇具诱惑，但算术结果要复杂得多。2023年，Tinubu先生在北部19个州及联邦首都领区仅领先Atiku先生约36.5万票，而在南部的领先约为146万票。再把北部进一步拆分，情况就会更鲜明。在西北部和东北部——即“核心北部”——Atiku先生实际上以约23.4万票获胜。这掩盖了两场不同的较量：Tinubu先生在西北部领先约32.3万票，Atiku先生在东北部领先约55.6万票。换言之，“Atiku拿下北部、Tinubu拿下南部”在很大程度上就是2023年的实际格局。Atiku先生的问题在于规模：Tinubu先生在南部的领先优势超过其核心北部优势的6倍。两个阵营之间横亘着北中部，这里不应被视为核心北部的附属地区。2023年，该地区选票由三方瓜分：Tinubu先生获约176万票，Obi先生和Kwankwaso先生合计约148万票，Atiku先生约116万票。Tinubu先生拿下Benue、Kogi、Kwara和Niger；Obi先生赢得Nasarawa、Plateau和联邦首都领区。这里既有倾向APC的地区、PDP的传统票仓、强大的Obi支持者基础，也有族裔和宗教构成多元的选民群，因此是真正的摇摆地带。如果Tinubu先生在北中部的选票有10%转投Atiku先生，将移动约17.6万张选票，并把两人正面对决的差距改变约35.2万票——意义显著，但单凭这一变化仍不足以决定胜负。它的杠杆作用在于放大核心北部的收复，或保护南方领先优势。现在剔除投票率提升、选票互换和搅局者，回到最简单的基准情景：按各州在1.034亿选民名册中的份额套用26.71%的投票率，同时维持2023年各州得票率。三个战场合计投出约2760万张选票。2023年的格局依然存在，但规模发生变化。Atiku先生在核心北部的领先缩小至约13.2万票，而Tinubu先生在南部的领先扩大至近190万票——是前者的14倍以上。北中部也远非中立：它又为Tinubu先生贡献了61万票。在南部尚未投出任何一票之前，他已在北部和联邦首都领区领先约47.9万票。现在测试一种对称的重新结盟：Tinubu先生在核心北部的一部分选民转投Atiku先生，同时Atiku先生在南部同样比例的选民转投Tinubu先生，北中部保持不变。相同的百分比并不意味着相同的人数。Tinubu先生的核心北部选民池（388万）几乎是Atiku先生南部选民池（210万）的两倍，因此10%的转投意味着约38.8万名北部选民转投Atiku先生，而只有约21万名南部选民转投Tinubu先生。悖论在于，两人在国家的不同半区都会变得更强。转投比例达到15%时，Atiku先生以近130万票领先核心北部，但Tinubu先生仍以约252万票领先南部，并以约184万票领先全国。凭借规模更大的选民池，Atiku先生缩小了差距，但速度缓慢：在两个阵营之间，持平所需的转投比例约为49.4%——这意味着Tinubu先生核心北部近一半支持者倒戈，同时Atiku先生在南部相同比例的选票转向另一边。这不是选情摇摆，而是阵营重组；即便如此，Tinubu先生在北中部拥有的61万票缓冲仍将保留。因此，北部收复对Atiku先生是必要的，却还不充分：他还必须阻止PDP在Rivers、Oyo、Ogun、Akwa Ibom及其他地区残留的南方选票流失。由此，北西部可以说才是决定性战场。Atiku先生已经在东北部击败Tinubu先生；规模更大、更难攻取的目标则在Kano、Kaduna、Katsina、Jigawa、Kebbi、Sokoto和Zamfara。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.summary: Education Minister Haruna Iddrisu has vowed that the sexual abuse allegations at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) will not be allowed to fade from public attention without a resolution. https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.summary_zh: 教育部长哈鲁纳·伊德里苏誓言，奥布阿西高级中学技术学校（SHTS）所涉性侵指控在得到解决之前，不会淡出公众视线。部长于2026年10月26日星期一在阿克拉举行的新闻发布会上表示，此案不会重蹈其他重大公共争议的模式：这些争议先在媒体上引发广泛关注，随后逐渐从全国公众讨论中消失。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body: Education Minister Haruna Iddrisu has vowed that the sexual abuse allegations at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) will not be allowed to fade from public attention without a resolution. Speaking at a press conference in Accra on Monday, October 26, 2026, the Minister said the case would not follow the pattern of other major public controversies that attract intense media attention before gradually disappearing from the national conversation. “Amid the calls from various sections of society for a full-scale investigation of similar malpractices in other educational institutions in the country, this scandal won't suffer the same fate as other burning issues which are normal to be discussed with gusto in the media over a period and then go out with a whimper. That won't happen in respect of this matter,” he said. Mr Iddrisu assured the public that the Ministry of Education would follow through on the case and work to ensure that justice is served. “The Ministry of Education would follow through and ensure that justice is done and justice will be done and will be seen to have been done,” he said. He also urged all parties involved to respect the legal process, stressing that the investigation must proceed in accordance with the law. “But due process will be followed and observed. So all parties must respect due process, and all parties must uphold the tenets and values and let the law take its course,” he added. The case has triggered national outrage, with 19 students reported to have made allegations of sexual abuse involving the school's headmaster, Zakaria Abdulai. The Ghana Education Service (GES) has suspended Mr Abdulai pending investigations, while the Ministry of Education has directed the Criminal Investigations Department of the Ghana Police Service to investigate the allegations. The controversy has also prompted calls for a wider inquiry into similar allegations in other educational institutions across the country
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.title_zh: 奥布阿西SHTS丑闻不会淡出公众视线
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body_zh: 教育部长哈鲁纳·伊德里苏誓言，奥布阿西高级中学技术学校（SHTS）的性侵指控在得到解决之前，绝不会任其淡出公众视线。部长于2026年10月26日星期一在阿克拉举行的新闻发布会上表示，此案不会重蹈其他重大公共争议的模式：这些争议先在媒体上受到广泛关注，随后逐渐从全国公众讨论中消失。他说：“鉴于社会各界均呼吁对全国其他教育机构的类似不当行为展开全面调查，这起丑闻不会遭遇其他热点议题的命运——这些议题通常会在媒体上受到热烈讨论一段时间，随后便悄无声息地淡出。就此事而言，这种情况不会发生。”伊德里苏先生向公众保证，教育部将跟进此案，并确保正义得到伸张。他说：“教育部将采取后续行动，确保正义得到伸张，而且正义必将得到伸张，人们也将看到正义已经得到伸张。”他还敦促所有相关各方尊重法律程序，强调调查必须依法进行。他补充道：“但正当程序将得到遵循和遵守。因此，所有各方都必须尊重正当程序，所有各方都必须维护基本原则和价值观，让法律自行发挥作用。”此案引发了全国公愤。据报道，19名学生指控该校校长扎卡里亚·阿卜杜莱涉及性侵行为。加纳教育局（GES）在调查期间已暂停阿卜杜莱先生职务；教育部则指示加纳警察局刑事调查局调查这些指控。这场争议还促使人们呼吁，对全国其他教育机构中的类似指控展开更广泛的调查

https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.title: MIIF, Forestry Commission partner to reforest Subri Forest Reserve
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.summary: The project is being undertaken in collaboration with the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, the Forestry Commission and the Environmental Protection Authority. Under a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), the Forestry Commission will provide technical expertise and oversee the implementation of the restoration project.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.summary_zh: 该项目正与土地和自然资源部、林业委员会及环境保护局合作开展。根据一份谅解备忘录，林业委员会将提供技术专长并监督恢复项目的实施。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.body: The project is being undertaken in collaboration with the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, the Forestry Commission and the Environmental Protection Authority. The initiative aims to restore degraded forest land, support biodiversity conservation and promote sustainable natural resource management in Ghana’s mining areas. Under a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), the Forestry Commission will provide technical expertise and oversee the implementation of the restoration project. Dubbed “Support of Forest Rehabilitation in Mining Regions and Promotion of Sustainability in Mining,” the project will be implemented over a two-year period and seeks to rehabilitate degraded portions of the Subri River Forest Reserve through targeted reforestation and restoration activities. Commenting on the initiative, the Chief Executive Officer of MIIF, Justina Nelson, said the project reflects MIIF’s commitment to ensuring that the benefits of Ghana’s mineral resources are pursued alongside responsible environmental management. “As an institution entrusted with managing Ghana’s mineral income and State interests in the mining sector, MIIF recognises that value creation must go hand in hand with environmental responsibility. “Restoring degraded forest landscapes is not only about planting trees; it is about protecting biodiversity and ensuring that communities can continue to benefit from our natural resources for generations to come,” she said. Mrs. Nelson added that the partnership demonstrates the importance of collaboration among government institutions and mining companies as well as local communities in addressing environmental challenges in mining regions adding: “We believe that meaningful partnerships such as this can make a lasting difference”. The scope of work will include site preparation, seedlings and other inputs, tree planting, monitoring and evaluation, stakeholder and community engagement, as well as Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) reporting. The project is expected to contribute to the restoration of degraded forest ecosystems, improve biodiversity, strengthen climate resilience and promote sustainable forest management in one of Ghana’s important forest reserves. It will also provide opportunities for local communities and other stakeholders to participate in forest restoration and conservation activities, reinforcing the importance of community involvement in protecting Ghana’s natural resources. On his part, the Chief Executive Officer of Zijin Golden Ridge Limited, Leon Zhang added: "We approach forest restoration as a long-term responsibility, not a one-time gesture. Our own biodiversity offset programme at Atewa reflects that. This partnership with MIIF and the Forestry Commission to restore the Subri River Forest Reserve carries that same commitment and focus."
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.title_zh: 加纳基础设施投资基金与林业委员会合作，为苏布里森林保护区重新造林
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.body_zh: 该项目与土地与自然资源部、林业委员会及环境保护局合作开展，旨在恢复退化的林地、支持生物多样性保护，并促进加纳矿区自然资源的可持续管理。根据一份谅解备忘录（MoU），林业委员会将提供技术专长并监督恢复项目的实施。该项目名为“支持矿区森林修复并促进采矿业可持续性”，计划在两年内实施，旨在通过有针对性的植树造林和生态修复活动，恢复Subri河森林保护区部分退化区域。MIIF首席执行官Justina Nelson在评论该项目时表示，该项目体现了MIIF的承诺，即在合理开发加纳矿产资源收益的同时，切实承担环境管理责任。她说：“作为一家受托管理加纳矿产收入以及采矿业国家利益的机构，MIIF深知，创造价值必须与环境责任并行。恢复退化的森林景观不仅是植树的问题；还关系到保护生物多样性，并确保社区能够世代继续从我们的自然资源中获益。”Nelson女士补充说，这一合作关系证明，政府机构、采矿企业和当地社区协作解决矿区环境挑战具有重要意义，并指出：“我们相信，此类富有意义的合作能够带来持久的改变”。工作范围包括场地准备、树苗及其他投入品采购、植树、监测与评估、利益相关方和社区参与，以及环境、社会和治理（ESG）报告。该项目预计将有助于恢复退化的森林生态系统、改善生物多样性、增强气候韧性，并促进加纳一处重要森林保护区的可持续森林管理。项目还将为当地社区和其他利益相关方参与森林恢复与保护活动提供机会，进一步凸显社区参与保护加纳自然资源的重要性。Zijin Golden Ridge Limited首席执行官Leon Zhang表示：“我们将森林恢复视为一项长期责任，而非一次性的姿态。我们在Atewa开展的生物多样性补偿计划就体现了这一点。我们与MIIF及林业委员会合作恢复Subri河森林保护区，同样体现了这一承诺和重点。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertain.body: The organisers of the Best of Nollywood (BON) Awards have announced Enugu State as the host of the 18th edition of the ceremony, scheduled for November, but kept the date and venue under wraps. In a statement sent to PREMIUM TIMES on Monday, the organisers said the event would attract filmmakers, actors and other entertainment industry stakeholders to the South-east for the annual celebration of Nigerian cinema. They said guests would arrive via the newly launched Enugu Air, which the state government has positioned as part of a major transport overhaul to improve domestic and international access to Akanu Ibiam International Airport. The organisers said the awards would do more than celebrate film and entertainment, describing the event as a chance to present Governor Peter Mbah’s $30 billion tourism economy to a global audience. They further said the ceremony would put six major tourism sites under development in the state in the international spotlight through global television coverage. The organisers said: “As November approaches, the anticipation is palpable. Nollywood’s biggest stakeholders, actors, and producers are preparing to descend on Enugu. “November in Enugu is shaping up to be an economic masterclass. Just as the BON Awards wrap up, the state will transition into hosting the 23rd National Sports Festival, the “Coal City Games,” beginning 27 November.” The organisers said delegates and nominees would visit Awhum Waterfall and Monastery, one of the event’s attractions. They said the 5.32km Okpatu-Awhum Cable Car, described as one of Africa’s longest, would provide access to the site. The itinerary also features the canopy walkways at the Nsude Pyramids, the Lejja Ancient Iron-Smelting Site and the Ngwo Pine Forest, which boasts Nigeria’s first 400-metre zipline. Other destinations include the Landmark Nike Lake Resort, which features West Africa’s second Upside-Down House, and the Centre for Memories (Ncheta Ndigbo), which showcases Igbo history and heritage. BON founder Seun Oloketuyi led a delegation to the state in August to present the hosting rights to the governor, this newspaper gathered. The delegation comprised Feranmi Olaoye, the awards’ executive producer; Tomi Falade; actor Enyinna Nwigwe; and Olukizzy Michael. In July, this newspaper reported that veteran actor Pete Edochie, actress and filmmaker Ruth Kadiri, actress Peju Ogunmola and filmmaker Steve Sodiya would receive Special Recognition Awards at the ceremony. According to the organisers, the four personalities earned the honours through their contributions to the film industry, long-standing careers, mentorship and impact on filmmakers and audiences. Edochie’s award recognises his decades in acting and his portrayal of authoritative, wise characters rooted in African culture. Kadiri would be honoured for her work as an actress, producer, and screenwriter, as well as her contributions to YouTube-based filmmaking. Ogunmola’s recognition reflects her work in Yoruba- and English-language films and her efforts to promote indigenous culture through theatre and cinema. Sodiya would receive the honour for his contributions as a filmmaker, editor and director, including his work in talent development and production. The Best of Nollywood Awards, founded in 2009 by the publisher of Nigerian Entertainment Today (NET), recognises excellence across Nigeria’s film industry. Its categories cover acting, directing, screenwriting and technical filmmaking in English and indigenous languages. The awards also present annual Special Recognition Awards to individuals whose contributions have helped advance the industry. The organisers said this year’s recipients represent different generations of Nollywood and have influenced its development through their work and mentorship
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertain.title_zh: 埃努古州将于11月主办BON奖颁奖典礼
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertain.body_zh:
Nollywood最佳作品（BON）奖主办方宣布，恩古州将承办第18届颁奖典礼，典礼定于11月举行，但具体日期和地点尚未公布。主办方周一发给《PREMIUM TIMES》的声明称，这场活动将吸引电影制片人、演员及娱乐行业其他相关人士来到尼日利亚东南部，参加这一尼日利亚电影年度盛会。

他们表示，来宾将通过新开通的Enugu Air抵达。恩古州政府将该航空服务定位为交通大改造的一部分，旨在改善通往Akanu Ibiam国际机场的国内和国际交通连接。

主办方表示，本届颁奖礼将不只是庆祝电影和娱乐事业，而是要借机向全球观众展示州长Peter Mbah推动的$30 billion旅游经济。他们进一步表示，典礼将通过全球电视报道，使该州正在开发的六大旅游胜地登上国际舞台。

主办方表示：“随着11月日益临近，人们的期待清晰可感。Nollywood最具影响力的相关人士、演员和制片人正准备齐聚恩古。

“恩古的11月正在成为一场经济盛宴。就在BON奖落下帷幕之际，该州将转入 hosting 第23届全国体育节——‘煤炭城运动会’，赛事将于11月27日开幕。”

主办方表示，代表和提名人士将参观Awhum瀑布及修道院，后者是活动亮点之一。他们表示，长5.32公里的Okpatu-Awhum索道被称为非洲最长的索道之一，将为前往该景点提供交通。行程还包括Nsude金字塔树冠步道、Lejja古铁冶炼遗址和Ngwo松林，后者拥有尼日利亚首条400米高空滑索。其他目的地包括Landmark Nike Lake度假村和记忆中心（Ncheta Ndigbo）；前者设有西非第二座倒置屋，后者展示伊博人的历史与文化遗产。

据《PREMIUM TIMES》了解，BON创始人Seun Oloketuyi于8月率领代表团访问该州，将主办权移交给州长。代表团成员包括该奖执行制片人Feranmi Olaoye、Tomi Falade、演员Enyinna Nwigwe和Olukizzy Michael。

《PREMIUM TIMES》曾在7月报道，资深演员Pete Edochie、演员兼电影制片人Ruth Kadiri、演员Peju Ogunmola以及电影制片人Steve Sodiya将在典礼上获得特别表彰奖。

主办方表示，这四位人士凭借对电影行业的贡献、长期职业生涯、导师作用以及对电影制片人和观众的影响而获此殊荣。Edochie获奖是为了表彰他数十年的表演生涯，以及他对植根于非洲文化的权威睿智角色的塑造。Kadiri将因其演员、制片人和编剧身份下的工作，以及对基于YouTube的电影制作的贡献而受到表彰。Ogunmola获得的认可体现了她在约鲁巴语和英语电影中的工作，以及她通过戏剧和电影推广本土文化的努力。Sodiya将因其作为电影制片人、剪辑师和导演的贡献而获奖，其中包括在人才培养和作品制作方面的工作。

Nollywood最佳作品奖由《Nigerian Entertainment Today》（NET）的出版人于2009年创办，旨在表彰尼日利亚电影行业各领域的杰出成就。奖项类别涵盖英语及本土语言电影中的表演、导演、编剧和技术制作。主办方表示，该奖还设有年度特别表彰奖，授予那些为推动行业发展作出贡献的人士。

主办方表示，今年的获奖者来自Nollywood的不同世代，并通过各自的工作和导师作用影响了行业发展……

https://www.inquirer.net/493907/westminc.body: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A Chinese Navy carrier fleet was spotted passing through waters off Mindanao last week, the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ (AFP) Western Mindanao Command (WestMinCom) disclosed on Monday. In a statement, WestMinCom said its Maritime Situational Awareness Center (MSAC-WM) and other maritime units tracked the People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) Liaoning Carrier Group as it transited the Zamboanga Peninsula region last Thursday, Oct. 22. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: [COVER STORY] Coupang issue becomes bellwether for Korea's treatment of US firms: ex-AMCHAM chief
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Seoul advised to prove US firms face no discrimination as trade talks hang in balance Korea risks damaging its economic ties with the United States, as perceived discrimination against American companies, most prominently Coupang, fuels a growing backlash in Washington that U.S. firms are being unfairly targeted, said Tami Overby, a former president of the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 首尔方面应证明美国企业未受到歧视，因为贸易谈判仍悬而未决。AMCHAM前会长塔米·欧弗比表示，朝鲜半岛经济关系可能因对 American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM) 的误解而受损。目前外界认为美国企业，尤其是 Coupang，受到歧视，这正在华盛顿激起日益强烈的反弹情绪，认为美国企业受到了不公平的针对。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Seoul advised to prove US firms face no discrimination as trade talks hang in balance Korea risks damaging its economic ties with the United States, as perceived discrimination against American companies, most prominently Coupang, fuels a growing backlash in Washington that U.S. firms are being unfairly targeted, said Tami Overby, a former president of the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM). “Many American observers increasingly see Korea's treatment of Coupang as a bellwether for how it treats successful American firms operating in its market,” Overby said Monday in a written interview with The Korea Times. After nearly four decades of observing Korea-U.S. economic ties, Overby said Washington is increasingly doubting whether Seoul remains committed to the principle of nondiscriminatory treatment for American businesses. She cautioned that mounting regulatory disputes could erode the trust underpinning bilateral economic cooperation at a critical time when the two countries are negotiating major investment commitments and U.S. tariffs. “Credibility depends not on statements but on outcomes,” she said, arguing that Korean authorities must demonstrate through their actions that U.S. companies receive equal treatment under domestic law. She served as president and CEO of AMCHAM from 1995 to 2009 before becoming senior vice president for Asia at the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, a position she held from 2014 to 2017. She is now a partner at Washington-based advisory firm DGA Group. Her warning comes as the two governments navigate negotiations involving Korea's $350 billion investment commitment in the U.S., including the proposed Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) project. The Donald Trump administration announced a $54 billion (71.6 trillion won) Korean investment in the project, although Seoul says it has not yet officially agreed. Overby said those commitments deserve recognition, but cautioned that investment alone cannot offset Washington's concerns about regulatory treatment. “The investment commitment is real and significant,” she said. “But investment alone cannot offset growing concerns about discrimination, regulatory targeting and strategic uncertainty.” The U.S.-listed e-commerce company has faced enforcement actions by Korea’s Fair Trade Commission (FTC) since disclosing a massive data breach affecting more than 33 million customers last November. The issue has attracted scrutiny from U.S. policymakers concerned about how U.S. businesses are treated in Korea, despite repeated explanations from Korean authorities that they do not discriminate against companies based on nationality. The trade expert said the case is increasingly being viewed in Washington as part of a repeated pattern rather than an isolated regulatory matter. She pointed to the Personal Information Protection Commission's penalty against Coupang, as well as the FTC's record of imposing large fines on American companies. “Alliances are built on reciprocity,” she said. “Economic partnerships depend on trust. When one side repeatedly promises nondiscrimination while a growing body of evidence suggests otherwise, it becomes increasingly difficult to maintain that trust.” While Korean regulators may contend that individual cases are justified under domestic law, she said the cumulative pattern risks reinforcing perceptions that U.S. companies face disproportionate scrutiny. Overby cited Korea’s proposed digital platform legislation and restrictions affecting U.S. cloud service providers seeking public-sector contracts. Korea's Cloud Security Assurance Program has been a point of contention for U.S. tech companies, which argue that Korea-specific security requirements limit their access to the public cloud market. Overby also pointed to a joint commitment made by Seoul and Washington last November that U.S. companies would not face discrimination or unnecessary barriers in areas including digital services, online platform regulation, network usage fees and cross-border data transfers. She said subsequent regulatory and legislative developments risk undermining that commitment, making it harder for Seoul to reassure Washington that its rules are applied fairly. “The U.S.-Korea relationship has weathered many challenges over the years,” she said. “The question now is whether Seoul recognizes the seriousness of the concerns emerging in Washington before those concerns begin to reshape the relationship itself.” The dispute could take on greater significance if concerns over the treatment of U.S. companies spill over into broader bilateral talks. Overby noted that some U.S. lawmakers have called for stronger responses to what they view as discriminatory treatment of American companies, including possible visa restrictions on foreign officials. While such proposals do not necessarily reflect established U.S. policy, their emergence highlights the issue’s growing political sensitivity in Washington, she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 封面报道：美国商会前会长称，Coupang事件成为审视韩国对待美国企业的风向标
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh:
首尔被要求证明美国企业未遭歧视，贸易谈判仍悬而未决：随着外界认为美国企业受到歧视，尤其是Coupang成为焦点，韩国可能损害其与美国的经贸关系。韩国美国商会（AMCHAM）前会长塔米·奥弗比周一接受《韩国时报》书面采访时表示，华盛顿日益强烈地反弹，认为美国企业受到了不公平针对。奥弗比说：“越来越多美国观察人士把韩国对Coupang的处理视为衡量韩国如何对待在其市场经营的成功美国企业的风向标。”奥弗比在观察韩美经济关系近40年后表示，华盛顿正日益怀疑首尔是否仍致力于对美资企业实行非歧视待遇原则。她警告说，在两国正就重大投资承诺和美国关税进行谈判的关键时期，不断加剧的监管争端可能侵蚀支撑双边经济合作的信任。她说：“公信力取决于结果，而非表态。”她认为，韩国主管部门必须以行动证明，美国企业在韩国国内法律下获得平等对待。奥弗比于1995年至2009年担任韩国美国商会会长兼首席执行官，随后于2014年至2017年担任美国商会亚洲高级副总裁。她目前是总部位于华盛顿的咨询公司DGA Group合伙人。

就在两国政府围绕韩国对美国3500亿美元投资承诺展开磋商之际，她发出警告，其中涉及拟议中的阿拉斯加液化天然气（LNG）项目。Donald Trump政府宣布韩国将对该项目投资540亿美元（71.6万亿韩元），不过首尔表示尚未正式同意。奥弗比说，这些投资承诺值得肯定，但她警告，仅靠投资无法消除华盛顿对监管待遇的担忧。她说：“投资承诺真实存在且意义重大，但投资本身无法抵消外界对歧视、监管定点针对和战略不确定性的日益担忧。”

这家在美上市电子商务公司自去年11月披露影响逾3300万名客户的大规模数据泄露事件以来，一直面临韩国公平交易委员会的执法行动。尽管韩国主管部门一再解释，不会基于企业国籍实施歧视，该问题仍引起美国政策制定者关注，他们担心美国企业在韩国受到何种待遇。这名贸易问题专家说，华盛顿正日益把此案视为反复出现的模式，而非单一监管事项。她列举了个人信息保护委员会对Coupang的处罚，以及公平交易委员会对美国企业处以巨额罚款的记录。

她说：“联盟建立在互惠基础之上，经济伙伴关系依赖信任。当一方反复承诺实行非歧视待遇，而越来越多的证据却指向相反情况时，维持这种信任就会变得越来越困难。”她表示，尽管韩国监管机构可能认为个案依据国内法律具有正当性，但累积起来的模式有可能进一步强化美国企业遭受不相称审查的印象。

奥弗比提到韩国拟议中的数字平台立法，以及影响寻求公共部门合同的美国云服务商的限制。韩国云安全保证计划一直是美国科技企业的争议焦点，它们认为韩国特有的安全要求限制了自身进入公共云市场的机会。奥弗比还指出，首尔和华盛顿去年11月共同承诺，在数字服务、在线平台监管、网络使用费和跨境数据传输等领域，美国企业不会遭受歧视或不必要的障碍。她说，此后的监管和立法进展有可能破坏这一承诺，使首尔更难向华盛顿保证其规则得到公平适用。

她说：“多年来，美韩关系经历了许多挑战。现在的问题是，在华盛顿方面日益涌现的担忧开始重塑两国关系之前，首尔是否认识到这些担忧的严重性。”

如果针对美国企业待遇的担忧外溢至更广泛的双边谈判，这场争端可能会变得更具重要性。奥弗比指出，一些美国议员已要求针对他们所认为的歧视性待遇采取更强硬的回应，包括可能对外国官员实施签证限制。她表示，尽管此类提议未必反映美国现行政策，但其出现凸显了该问题在华盛顿日益上升的政治敏感性。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Tami Overby is a veteran U.S. business executive and trade advocate who played a key role in strengthening economic ties between Korea and the United States, including efforts to advance the Korea-U.S. Free Trade Agreement (KORUS FTA) and expand travel access for Korean citizens. During her tenure as president and CEO of the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM) from 1995 to 2009, Overby was directly involved in bilateral trade discussions and advocated policies aimed at improving market access and business conditions for U.S. companies operating in Korea. In 2009, former President Lee Myung-bak personally presented Overby with the Silver Tower Order of Industrial Service Merit in recognition of her contributions to attracting foreign investment to Korea over more than two decades and advancing the bilateral trade pact. The honor reflected her longstanding efforts to promote Korea as an investment destination for American businesses and deepen commercial ties between the two countries. She also contributed to efforts that led to Korea's inclusion in the U.S. visa waiver program, which took effect in November 2008 and allowed eligible Korean travelers to visit the U.S. for tourism and business without a visa for stays of up to 90 days. Overby's work has spanned trade policy, investment promotion and business diplomacy, positioning her as a longtime participant in efforts to strengthen the commercial relationship between Seoul and Washington.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 塔米·欧弗比是美国资深企业高管和贸易倡导者，她在加强韩国与美国经济关系方面发挥了关键作用，包括推动韩美自由贸易协定（KORUS FTA）以及扩大韩国公民赴美旅行便利。1995年至2009年担任美国商会驻韩国分会（AMCHAM）总裁兼首席执行官期间，欧弗比直接参与双边贸易谈判，并倡导改善美国企业在韩国经营的市场准入和商业环境的政策。2009年，时任总统李明博亲自向欧弗比授予工业服务功绩银塔勋章，以表彰她二十多年来为吸引外国投资进入韩国以及推动双边贸易协定所作的贡献。这项荣誉体现了她长期致力于将韩国打造为美国企业的投资目的地，并深化两国商业联系。她还参与推动韩国纳入美国免签证计划的工作。该计划于2008年11月生效，允许符合条件的韩国旅客免签证赴美旅游和商务访问，停留时间最长可达90天。欧弗比的工作涵盖贸易政策、投资促进和商业外交，使她成为推动首尔与华盛顿加强商业关系的长期参与者。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun plans to visit the United States this week to attend a Group of 20 (G20) foreign ministers' meeting to discuss ways to address global challenges with partner nations and strengthen international cooperation, the foreign ministry said Monday. During his five-day visit to Atlanta starting Thursday, Cho plans to exchange views with his counterparts on major challenges facing the international community, including geopolitical issues, energy and supply chains, and discuss ways to promote cooperation within the G20, according to a ministry official. South Korea is set to assume the G20 presidency in 2028, and the government plans to work closely with member countries to ensure continued progress in discussions on various global issues, he added. Cho is also seeking bilateral meetings with his counterparts from major countries on the sidelines of the gathering. If a meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio takes place, they are expected to exchange views on developments on the Korean Peninsula, including North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's recent visit to China, as well as other bilateral issues. Meetings with major European counterparts, including Germany, could include discussions on the crisis in the Middle East and the war in Ukraine, the official said. On Saturday, Kim visited the Chinese border city of Dandong, where he met with Wang Huning, China's top political adviser, and vowed to advance the longstanding friendship between Pyongyang and Beijing. The visit came ahead of a planned Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in China next month, which U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to attend. Trump has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Kim, though prospects for a meeting remain uncertain
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 赵兑烈本周将赴美国出席二十国集团外长会议
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显计划于本周访问美国，参加二十国集团（G20）外长会议，与伙伴国讨论应对全球挑战的方法并加强国际合作。外交部周一声明称，从周四开始，赵显将对亚特兰大进行为期5天的访问。一位外交部官员表示，赵显计划与各国同行就国际社会面临的主要挑战交换意见，包括地缘政治问题、能源和供应链问题，并讨论如何在G20框架内促进合作。他还补充说，韩国将于2028年担任G20轮值主席国，政府计划与成员国密切合作，确保全球各项问题的讨论持续取得进展。赵显还希望利用会议间隙，与主要国家的同行举行双边会谈。如果他与美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥会面，双方预计将就朝鲜半岛局势，包括朝鲜领导人金正恩近期访华，以及其他双边问题交换意见。该官员表示，与德国等欧洲主要国家同行的会谈可能包括讨论中东危机和乌克兰战争。周六，金正恩访问了中国边境城市丹东，在那里会见了中国最高政治顾问王沪宁，并誓言推动平壤与北京之间的长期友谊。此次访问是在中国计划于下月举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会之前进行的，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普预计将出席峰会。特朗普已表示有兴趣恢复与金正恩的对话，但双方会面的前景仍不确定

https://www.myjoyonline.com/tor-receives.summary_zh: 特马石油炼油厂在2024年一度没有接收原油后，现已获得超过500万桶原油。董事总经理埃德蒙·孔巴特透露了这一情况。他说，重新获得原油供应 reflects 了供应商和商业伙伴对该炼油厂恢复运营所作努力日益增强的信心。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/tor-receives.body: The Tema Oil Refinery (TOR) has received more than five million barrels of crude oil following a period in which it recorded no crude receipts in 2024, Managing Director Edmond Kombat has disclosed. He said the renewed supply of crude reflected growing confidence among suppliers and business partners following efforts to restore the refinery’s operations. Speaking at the Government Accountability Series at Jubilee House on Monday, October 26, 2026, Mr Kombat said TOR had received several crude cargoes since the recovery programme began, including shipments of Ghanaian indigenous crude. “TOR has maintained a steady supply of crude oil for refinery operations, reflecting the renewed confidence among suppliers and business partners, who are once again willing to do business with the refinery,” he said. The Managing Director listed Bonga, Baleine and Bonnie Light among the crude grades received since May 2026, followed by Ghana’s Jubilee Medium Sweet crude delivered aboard the MT Apache on July 15, 2026. He said TOR paid for the Jubilee cargo in full, describing it as the refinery’s first Jubilee crude shipment in a decade. On September 25, 2026, the refinery received a further 950,000-barrel shipment of Sankofa crude from the Ghana National Petroleum Corporation (GNPC). The crude deliveries followed the restart of refining operations on December 19, 2025, after the completion of turnaround maintenance on the Crude Distillation Unit (CDU). Mr Kombat said the restoration of crude supplies had been central to management’s efforts to return TOR to its core mandate of processing crude oil into petroleum products for the domestic market. He explained that the refinery had been largely inactive when the current management took office in May 2025, with the CDU out of operation since April 2021 and the Residue Fluid Catalytic Cracking (RFCC) Unit shut down since 2019. Management subsequently prioritised the rehabilitation of the CDU, with turnaround maintenance conducted between August 1 and October 30, 2025. Following inspections by the National Petroleum Authority, the refinery received clearance to resume refining operations. The refurbished CDU was commissioned by President John Dramani Mahama on August 1, 2026. Mr Kombat said the crude deliveries and renewed commercial relationships demonstrated the importance of collaboration among state institutions and private-sector partners in restoring TOR. He said management would continue working to ensure a steady supply of crude, improve operational efficiency and increase processing capacity
https://www.myjoyonline.com/tor-receives.title_zh: 2024年零原油接收量后，TOR收到逾500万桶原油
https://www.myjoyonline.com/tor-receives.body_zh: 特马炼油厂（TOR）总经理埃德蒙·孔巴特披露，在2024年一度没有原油接收量的那段时期之后，该炼油厂已收到逾500万桶原油。他说，恢复原油供应反映了供应商和商业伙伴日益增强的信心，此前炼油厂为恢复运营作出了努力。孔巴特先生于2026年10月26日星期一在禧禧宫举行的政府问责系列活动上表示，自恢复计划启动以来，TOR已接收数批原油货物，其中包括加纳本土原油船货。他说：“TOR一直为炼油作业保持稳定的原油供应，这反映出供应商和商业伙伴恢复了对该炼油厂的信心，他们再次愿意与炼油厂开展业务。”总经理列出了自2026年5月以来接收的多种原油品级，包括Bonga、Baleine和Bonnie Light，随后是于2026年7月15日由MT Apache号运载送达的加纳Jubilee Medium Sweet原油。他说，TOR已全额支付Jubilee船货的货款，并称这是该炼油厂十年来首次接收Jubilee原油。2026年9月25日，该炼油厂又从加纳国家石油公司（GNPC）接收了95万桶Sankofa原油。上述原油交付是在原油蒸馏装置（CDU）完成 turnaround检修，并于2025年12月19日重启炼油作业之后进行的。孔巴特先生称，恢复原油供应一直是管理层推动TOR回归核心职责的重要举措，即为国内市场将原油加工为石油产品。他解释说，现任管理层于2025年5月上任时，炼油厂基本处于停运状态，CDU自2021年4月起无法运行，渣油流体催化裂化（RFCC）装置自2019年起一直停产。随后，管理层将CDU的修复列为优先事项，并于2025年8月1日至10月30日进行了turnaround检修。在接受国家石油管理局检查后，该炼油厂获准恢复炼油作业。翻修后的CDU由总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马于2026年8月1日主持启用。孔巴特先生表示，原油交付和重塑的商业合作关系证明，国有机构与私营部门伙伴之间的协作对于恢复TOR至关重要。他说，管理层将继续努力，确保原油供应稳定、提高运营效率并提升加工能力

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Anambra State Government has called on the Nigeria Medical Association (NMA) to support its efforts to eradicate quack and unregistered health facilities in the state. Adam Obidike, the commissioner for health in Anambra made the appeal during the closing ceremony of the 2026 Physicians Week and Scientific Conference of the Nigerian Medical Association, Awka Zone in Awka on Sunday. The theme of the Week, Luncheon and Award Presentation Ceremony was “Securing the Future of Medicine in Nigeria and Sub-Saharan Africa”. Mr Obidike, a medical doctor, said the NMA was a critical partner and that the government would collaborate with the association to track fake and unregistered facilities. “We are determined to shut all of them down because when people go there, they receive treatment that is not proper for their ailment. “We have a checklist and anybody who wants to set up a facility should go to the department of medical services and get the conditions, including the design of the building,” he said. In his welcome address, Tim-Uzoma Mbaeri, chairman of NMA, Awka Zone, said this year’s Physicians Week and Scientific Conference was a time to celebrate the profession and reconnect members with each other. Mr Mbaeri, a professor, said the association used the event to visit sick colleagues, provide free laboratory tests including prostate specific antigens testing, urinalysis among others. He thanked members and partners of the NMA, Awka branch, whose contributions ensured the success of the physicians’ week. “We also enjoyed a novelty football match, had an opportunity for friendship, recreation, and strong inter-agency relationships. “We find satisfaction not merely in the event we organised, but in the lives we have touched, the colleagues we have encouraged, the relationships we have strengthened and the visibility we have given to our profession,” he said. Mr Mbaeri said three personalities were honoured with awards of meritorious service to the medical profession and the NMA, including Ifeoma Njelita, Emmanuel Umenweke and Amaka Ezeno. Njelita is an associate professor and a consultant in community medicine at the Chukwuemeka Odumegwu Ojukwu University Teaching Hospital. Umenweke is a medical doctor with the Nnamdi Azikiwe University Medical Center, Awka while Ezeno, the third awardee is a lawyer, Notary Public and member of the Body of Benchers
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 安ambra州政府寻求尼日利亚医学会支持打击非法医疗机构
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 阿纳姆拉州政府已呼吁尼日利亚医学协会支持该州打击、取缔虚假及未注册医疗机构的努力。阿纳姆拉州卫生专员亚当·奥比迪克于周日在奥沃卡举行的尼日利亚医学协会奥沃卡区分会2026年医师周暨科学会议闭幕式上提出这一呼吁。本届医师周、午餐会及颁奖典礼的主题是“保障尼日利亚和撒哈拉以南非洲医学的未来”。身为医学博士的奥比迪克先生表示，尼日利亚医学协会是重要的合作伙伴，政府将与该协会合作，追踪虚假和未注册的医疗机构。他说：“我们决心关闭所有这类机构，因为人们前往那里接受的治疗并不适合其疾病。我们有一份清单，任何想设立医疗机构的人都应前往医疗服务部门了解相关条件，包括建筑设计方案。”尼日利亚医学协会奥沃卡区分会主席蒂姆·乌佐马·姆巴埃里在欢迎辞中表示，今年的医师周暨科学会议是庆祝医学职业、让会员彼此重新联络交流的时刻。姆巴埃里教授说，该协会利用这次活动探望患病同事，并提供免费实验室检测，包括前列腺特异性抗原检测、尿液分析等。他感谢尼日利亚医学协会奥沃卡分会的会员和合作伙伴，正是他们的贡献确保了医师周圆满成功。他说：“我们还举办了一场别开生面的足球赛，获得了交流友谊、放松娱乐和加强机构间关系的机会。我们不仅从自己组织的活动中获得满足，也从帮助他人、鼓励同事、加强联系以及提升本职业社会可见度中感受到价值。”姆巴埃里先生表示，3人因对医学职业和尼日利亚医学协会作出卓越贡献而获颁奖项，包括伊费奥马·恩杰利塔、埃马纽埃尔·乌门韦克和阿玛卡·埃泽诺。恩杰利塔是楚库韦梅卡·奥杜梅格武·奥朱克武大学教学医院的社区医学副教授及顾问医师。乌门韦克是奥沃卡南纳姆迪·阿齐基韦大学医学中心的医学博士，第三位获奖者埃泽诺则是律师、公证人及律师公会成员。

https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.summary: The Chinese embassy did not confirm that President Marcos sent Duterte to The Hague at Senator Pangilinan's request, contradicting claims made on social media. The embassy's response to Pangilinan's remarks was rhetorical and did not affirm any statements regarding Duterte's arrest or the senator's request. Claim: The Chinese embassy confirmed that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. sent former president Rodrigo Duterte to The Hague at Senator Kiko Pangilinan’s request.
https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.summary_zh: 中国大使馆没有证实马科斯总统应帕尼利南参议员的要求将杜特尔特送往海牙，此事与社交媒体上的说法相矛盾。中国大使馆对帕尼利南言论的回应仅是反问，并未确认任何有关杜特尔特被捕或参议员提出请求的说法。相关说法称：中国大使馆证实，费迪南德·马科斯三世总统应基科·帕尼利南参议员的要求，将前总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特送往海牙。
https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.body: Already have Rappler+? Sign in to listen to groundbreaking journalism. The Chinese embassy did not confirm that President Marcos sent Duterte to The Hague at Senator Pangilinan's request, contradicting claims made on social media. The embassy's response to Pangilinan's remarks was rhetorical and did not affirm any statements regarding Duterte's arrest or the senator's request. Duterte's arrest in March 2025 was based on an ICC warrant, and the ICC has denied any collusion with the Philippine administration regarding the case. This is AI-generated. Read the article for full context. Report any errors . Claim: The Chinese embassy confirmed that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. sent former president Rodrigo Duterte to The Hague at Senator Kiko Pangilinan’s request. The posts were made on October 21, 2026, several hours after the Chinese embassy in Manila responded to Senator Kiko Pangilinan’s remarks on Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan. As of writing, the posts drew a total of 7,400 reactions, more than 1,000 comments, and 1,254 shares. The facts: While the Chinese embassy did undermine Pangilinan, it did not say that the senator requested Marcos to send Duterte to The Hague. Instead, the embassy replied to an earlier post made by Pangilinan asking the President to send Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan back to China. In his post , Pangilinan wrote: “Mr. President, if you can send Duterte, Quiboloy and Remualdez to jail… then you can most certainly send this arrogant, insulting, crude and insolent alien back to his country of origin,” referring to the Chinese Ambassador. The Chinese embassy’s official Facebook page only responded with rhetorical questions regarding the senator’s language. It did not officially affirm his statements on Duterte, Quiboloy, and Romualdez. The embassy’s post read: “Using thuggish, hooligan-style language to launch personal attacks on others—is this the calibre and standards of a Philippine senator? Is this the diplomacy and prudence that the DFA claims to uphold?” Duterte’s arrest: In March 2025, Duterte’s arrest was facilitated by Philippine authorities, in accordance with an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC) on charges of crimes against humanity . President Marcos affirmed that this facilitation complied with the Philippines’ commitment to the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol). The ICC has also repeatedly refuted allegations of dependence on the Philippine administration. In a statement sent to the Inquirer , ICC spokesperson Oriane Maillet said the court is mandated to operate independently and impartially under the Rome Statute. A separate interview with ICC spokesperson Fadi El Abdallah presents a denial of collusion with the Marcos administration, as court judges make decisions independently. Chinese embassy and the West Philippine Sea: In an interview with the media on October 15 , the ambassador said the Philippines “should feel fortunate” that China does not use force in its maritime dispute. His statement was a response to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr.’s statement saying Beijing was a troublemaker in the region, and not Manila. Public officials, including Pangilinan, then reacted to the ambassador’s statement. Before this incident, it was reported that since Jing took over in December 2025, the Chinese embassy in Manila has amplified its rhetoric and engaged in online word wars with Philippine government spokespersons and officials. Previous fact-checks: As the maritime dispute continues, Duterte remains at the ICC . The actual trial will begin on November 30. Rappler has previously fact-checked claims regarding Duterte at the ICC: Jade Florido is a volunteer for Rappler’s Research and Data unit. She is a third-year Development Studies student at the University of the Philippines – Manila. https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.title_zh: 事实核查：中国大使馆并未证实杜特尔蒂遭国际刑事法院“策划”逮捕
https://www.rappler.com/newsbreak/fact-c.body_zh: 已经订阅Rappler+？登录即可收听突破性新闻。中国大使馆没有确认马科斯总统应参议员帕尼利南的请求将杜特尔特送往海牙，此举与社交媒体上的说法相悖。大使馆对帕尼利南言论的回应是反问式的，没有确认任何有关杜特尔特被捕或参议员提出请求的说法。杜特尔特于2025年3月被捕的依据是国际刑事法院的逮捕令，国际刑事法院也否认了与菲律宾政府就该案存在任何串通。本文由人工智能生成。阅读全文以了解完整背景。报告任何错误。说法：中国大使馆确认，费迪南德·马科斯三世总统应参议员基科·帕尼利南的请求，将前总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特送往海牙。这些帖子发布于2026年10月21日，即中国驻马尼拉大使馆回应参议员基科·帕尼利南针对中国大使景泉言论的数小时后。截至撰稿时，这些帖子共获得7,400次互动、逾1,000条评论和1,254次分享。事实：虽然中国大使馆确实反驳了帕尼利南，但没有说参议员请求马科斯将杜特尔特送往海牙。相反，大使馆回复的是帕尼利南早先发布的一则帖子，该帖要求总统将中国大使景泉送回中国。帕尼利南在帖子中写道：“总统先生，如果您能把杜特尔特、基博洛伊和雷穆亚尔德斯送进监狱……那么您当然也能把这个傲慢、侮辱别人、粗鲁和无礼的外国人送回他的原籍国。”他指的是中国大使。中国大使馆的官方脸书页面只用反问回应了参议员措辞问题，没有正式确认他关于杜特尔特、基博洛伊和罗穆亚尔德斯的说法。大使馆的帖子写道：“使用暴徒、流氓式的语言对他人进行人身攻击——这就是菲律宾参议员的水准和标准吗？这就是外交部声称要维护的外交和审慎吗？”杜特尔特被捕：2025年3月，杜特尔特在菲律宾当局配合国际刑事法院签发的逮捕令下被捕，罪名是危害人类罪。马科斯总统确认，这一协助行动符合菲律宾对国际刑警组织的承诺。国际刑事法院也多次驳斥了有关该法院依赖菲律宾政府的指控。国际刑事法院发言人奥里安·梅莱特向《问询者报》发来声明称，根据《罗马条例》，该法院必须独立、公正地运作。国际刑事法院发言人法迪·埃尔·阿卜杜拉在接受另一次采访时否认与马科斯政府串通，并表示法院法官独立作出决定。中国大使馆与西菲律宾海：10月15日接受媒体采访时，大使表示，在海洋争端中，中国没有使用武力，菲律宾“应该感到幸运”。这番言论是针对国防部长小吉尔伯特·特奥多罗的说法，后者称北京是该地区的麻烦制造者，而不是马尼拉。包括帕尼利南在内的菲律宾公职人员随后对大使的这番言论作出反应。据报道，在此次事件之前，自2025年12月景泉接任大使以来，中国驻马尼拉大使馆一直强化其言辞，与菲律宾政府发言人和官员在网上展开口水战。此前的核查：随着海洋争端持续，杜特尔特仍被关押在国际刑事法院。审判将于11月30正式开始。Rappler此前已核查过有关杜特尔特在国际刑事法院案件的说法：哈德·弗洛里多是Rappler研究与数据部门的志愿者。她是菲律宾大学马尼拉校区发展研究专业三年级学生。如果您在社交网络上发现可疑的脸书页面、群组、账号、网站、文章或照片，请通过factcheck@rappler.com联系我们。让我们一次核查一条信息，共同打击虚假信息。订阅Rappler+，解锁独家内容和无限访问权限

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 据朝鲜官方媒体周一报道，朝鲜官员在平壤友谊塔向阵亡中国军人敬献花圈，以纪念他们。此前，朝鲜领导人Kim Jong-un于上周突袭访问中国丹东。朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）称，高级官员于周日在纪念碑前敬献花圈，纪念中国志愿军参加1950—53年朝鲜战争76周年。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korean officials have paid tribute at the Friendship Tower in Pyongyang in honor of fallen Chinese soldiers, state media reported Monday, after leader Kim Jong-un's surprise day trip to China's Dandong last week. The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) said senior officials laid wreaths at the monument Sunday to mark the 76th anniversary of the Chinese People's Volunteers' entry into the 1950-53 Korean War. Among them were Kim Hyong-sik, vice chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly standing committee, and Vice Foreign Minister Kim Myong-su. They were joined by Chinese embassy officials, including Qi Han, charge d'affaires ad interim, and a Chinese delegation led by Hong Zongming, vice minister of China's veterans affairs ministry. Wreaths were also laid at cemeteries and graves of Chinese soldiers in Anju, Hoechang County, Onsong County and Kaesong. The Chinese side hosted a reception later Sunday to mark the anniversary, the report added. The North Korean leader traveled to the Chinese border city of Dandong on Saturday, a trip meant to showcase the decades-old alliance with China and mark the anniversary. He visited a war memorial to Chinese soldiers who fought in the Korean War, attended a banquet and toured a bus factory

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's budget ministry said Monday it will begin reviewing spending restructuring measures in November for inclusion in the 2028 budget proposal, as part of efforts to develop detailed plans to improve spending efficiency. The Ministry of Planning and Budget unveiled the plan after incorporating 88 measures to cut spending by 44.2 trillion won ($33.4 billion) into the 2027 budget proposal. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国祖国和 Veterans Affairs 部周一表示，一名参加1950年至1953年朝鲜战争的法国老兵遗骸将于周二运抵韩国，并于本周末安葬在釜山联合国纪念公墓，从而实现他希望长眠于曾经为之战斗的国家的遗愿。谢尔盖·阿尔尚博于6月5日去世，享年96岁。他主动报名参战，于1951年10月至1952年9月担任联合国军法国营第3连反坦克火箭炮手。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The remains of a French veteran of the 1950-53 Korean War will be brought to Korea on Tuesday and buried at the U.N. Memorial Cemetery in Busan this weekend, fulfilling his wish that he be laid to rest in the country he fought for, the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs said Monday. Serge Archambeau, who died on June 5 at the age of 96, volunteered for the war and served as a bazooka gunner with the 3rd Company of the French Battalion, part of the United Nations forces, from October 1951 to September 1952. He fought in some of the war’s fiercest battles, including the so-called Battle of T-Bone Hill and the Battle of the Iron Triangle, and received the Cross for Military Valour with bronze star and other French honors. His remains will arrive at Incheon International Airport’s Terminal 2 on Tuesday. Roger Quintard, secretary-general of a French veterans’ association and executor of Archambeau’s will, will accompany them because the veteran’s family is unable to travel for health reasons. A ceremony marking the arrival of the remains will begin at 12:20 p.m. A Ministry of National Defense honor guard will escort the remains to a hearse. Attendees will include Michel Miraillet, the French charge d’affaires in Seoul. Also attending will be Roland Monclar, son of Gen. Ralph Monclar, who voluntarily took a demotion from lieutenant general to lieutenant colonel so he could lead the French battalion in Korea. The burial, hosted by the French Embassy, will take place Saturday at 2 p.m. Vice Minister Kang Yun-jin and crew members of the French Navy frigate Vendemiaire will attend. “Today’s Korea exists thanks to the dedication of the U.N. veterans who fought at the cost of their lives in the brightest years of their youth,” Minister Kwon Oh-eul said. He noted that the burial falls in the year marking 140 years of diplomatic ties between Korea and France. Archambeau will be the 39th U.N. veteran buried at the cemetery since 2015. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 法国朝鲜战争老兵遗骸将在釜山安葬
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国祖国和 veterans 事务部周一表示，一名参加1950年至1953年朝鲜战争的法国老兵的遗骸将于周二运抵韩国，并于本周末安葬于釜山联合国纪念公墓，从而实现他安葬在曾经效力过的国家的遗愿。96岁的 Serge Archambeau 于6月5日去世。他自愿参战，于1951年10月至1952年9月担任联合国部队法国营第3连的一名火箭筒手。他参加过战争中最激烈的几场战斗，包括所谓的“T骨山战役”和“铁三角战役”，并获得带铜星的军事勇气十字勋章及法国其他荣誉。他的遗骸将于周二抵达仁川国际机场2号航站楼。法国退伍军人协会秘书长、Archambeau 遗嘱执行人 Roger Quintard 将陪同遗骸前来，因为这位老兵的家人因健康原因无法出行。迎候遗骸抵达的仪式将于中午12时20分开始。国防部礼宾仪仗队将护送遗骸登上灵车。出席人员包括法国驻首尔代办 Michel Miraillet。法国海军“旺多姆号”护卫舰船员也将参加由法国大使馆主办、于周六下午2时举行的安葬仪式。副部长 Kang Yun-jin 和法国海军“旺多姆号”护卫舰船员将出席。Kwon Oh-eul 部长说：“今天的韩国，得益于联合国老兵在人生最灿烂的年华以生命为代价所付出的奉献。”他指出，此次安葬恰逢韩法建交140周年。Archambeau 将成为自2015年以来安葬在该公墓的第39名联合国老兵。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。
