https://x.com/dana916/status/21147516680.title: 🇻🇳A Canal of Discord Vietnam Assesses New Risks A major infrastructure project has the potential to alter not only trade routes but also rel
https://x.com/dana916/status/21147516680.snippet:
🇻🇳A Canal of Discord
Vietnam Assesses New Risks

A major infrastructure project has the potential to alter not only trade routes but also relations with neighboring states - especially when the economic calculations appear to mask the geopolitical interests of a third party.

In Cambodia, construction of the Funan Techo Canal is gradually moving forward. This new 180-kilometer-long shipping route will provide a direct link between the capital, Phnom Penh, and the Gulf of Thailand, bypassing the Mekong River Delta.

The project is estimated to cost approximately $1.2 billion. The primary contractor is the Chinese firm China Road and Bridge Corporation (CRBC), while the main lender is the Export-Import Bank of China.

The primary objective is to reduce the dependence of Cambodia’s foreign trade on Vietnam’s transport infrastructure. Currently, the majority of cargo moving along river routes toward the Cambodian capital passes through Vietnamese territory and ports.

While Hanoi does not officially oppose Cambodia’s right to develop the project, it insists on a joint assessment of its transboundary impacts. For Vietnam, this is a matter involving national security, economic development, and a shift in the strategic landscape.

A Potential Threat to National Interests

▪️Vietnam is particularly concerned about disruptions to the hydrological regime downstream of the Mekong and Bassac rivers. This is precisely why Hanoi is pushing for an exchange of technical data and a collaborative evaluation of the project’s consequences.

▪️For Vietnam, the emergence of this new Cambodian route implies a reduction in transit flows and cargo turnover at its ports. Furthermore, it weakens one of the key mechanisms of economic interdependence between the two nations. 

▪️Strategically, the canal will strengthen Cambodia’s ties with China, further increasing the significance of the "Chinese factor" in the regional balance. Vietnam is compelled to take these shifts along its southwestern borders into account - especially given the unresolved disputes to its east, in the South China Sea.

Formally, Cambodia has presented the shipping route as its own independent initiative. In practice, however, its implementation is gradually becoming integrated into a broader framework of Sino-Cambodian cooperation, aligned with Beijing’s "Belt and Road Initiative."

It is precisely this Chinese involvement that gives the canal a geopolitical dimension. For Beijing, it represents an opportunity to expand its footprint within the infrastructure of mainland Southeast Asia, complementing the high-speed railway network already operating in Laos and currently under construction in Thailand.

❗️Ultimately, the project’s primary impact will not merely be the success with which cargo is transported along the canal to Phnom Penh; equally significant will be how it influences the distribution of economic and political influence across the region.

在柬埔寨，扶南—德昭运河的建设正在逐步推进。这条全长180公里的新航道将直接连接首都金边和泰国湾，绕过湄公河三角洲。

该项目预计耗资约12亿美元。主要承包商是中国企业中国路桥工程有限责任公司（CRBC），主要贷款方是中国进出口银行。

主要目标是减少柬埔寨对外贸易对越南运输基础设施的依赖。目前，经水路运往柬埔寨首都的大多数货物都要经过越南境内和港口。

尽管河内方面并未正式反对柬埔寨开发该项目的权利，但它坚持要求双方联合评估项目对跨境地区造成的影响。对越南而言，这涉及国家安全、经济发展以及战略格局的转变。

对国家利益的潜在威胁

▪️越南尤其担忧湄公河和巴萨河下游水文状况受到干扰。正因如此，河内方面正推动双方交换技术数据，并合作评估该项目带来的后果。

▪️对越南而言，这条新的柬埔寨航线意味着过境货物流和港口货物吞吐量将减少。此外，它还会削弱两国经济相互依存的关键机制之一。

▪️从战略角度看，该运河将加强柬埔寨与中国的联系，进一步提升“因素中国”在地区力量平衡中的重要性。越南不得不考虑其西南边境发生的这些变化，尤其是考虑到其东部南海争端尚未解决。

柬埔寨正式将这条航道描述为本国独立提出的倡议。然而在实际实施中，它正逐步纳入更广泛的中柬合作框架，并与北京的“一带一路倡议”相衔接。

正是中国的参与使这条运河具有地缘政治意义。对北京而言，这是一个扩大自身在东南亚大陆基础设施领域影响力的机会，可与老挝已经运营、泰国正在建设的高速铁路网络形成互补。

❗️归根结底，该项目的主要影响不仅在于货物能否成功经由运河运往金边；它对地区经济与政治影响力分布格局的影响同样至关重要。

Corrected information

The viral video is a deepfake. 

Original footage is from 27 October 2023, when then Maj Gen Girish Kalia (GOC 28 Infantry Division) was briefing in Kupwara, Jammu & Kashmir about Pakistani infiltration attempts across the Line of Control. He reported that 10 attempts were foiled, 27 terrorists were eliminated, and warlike stores + narcotics were recovered. He made no statements about China, Arunachal Pradesh, Asaphila, Longju, Taksing, denial of supplies, or deploying forces against local youth.[](<>)

The circulating version has digitally altered/fabricated audio overlaid on the old footage. Indian Army fact-check accounts and independent analysis have confirmed this. The claims that Lt Gen Kalia “admitted” Chinese control of those areas are false.[](<https://t.co/pxxpCGJL5R>)
Actual border situation (as of late October 2026)
Face-offs between Indian and Chinese troops have continued at multiple locations along the Arunachal Pradesh border. ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur publicly confirmed this.[](<https://t.co/eG11b7RNnu>)
A specific stand-off has been ongoing since late July 2026 near Asaphila / Taksing (Upper Subansiri district). Chinese PLA troops reportedly pitched tents roughly 6–7 km within India’s perception of the LAC near the Maja company operating base.
India has increased its deployment. Corps Commander-level talks were held in the Eastern Sector in September 2026.
Claims of full Chinese “control” of entire Asaphila, Longju, and Taksing circles are exaggerated and not supported by official statements. These are contested areas with differing perceptions of the LAC, not confirmed occupation of the circles as claimed in the deepfake.

---
Suggested tweet (factual, clear, and shareable)

```
🚨 DEEPFAKE ALERT

A manipulated video falsely claims Lt Gen Girish Kalia said China has taken control of Asaphila, Longju & Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh.

Fact: Original video is from 27 Oct 2023 — then Maj Gen Kalia was briefing in Kupwara (J&K) on Pakistani LoC infiltrations (10 attempts foiled, 27 terrorists eliminated). Audio was digitally altered.

There ARE ongoing face-offs with Chinese troops at multiple points in Arunachal (confirmed by ITBP DG), including a stand-off near Taksing since July. But the viral claims of “control” and the officer’s alleged statements are fake.

Verify before sharing.
#FactCheck #Deepfake
```

https://x.com/imarunsharma/status/211457.snippet_zh:
更正信息

该病毒式传播的视频是深度伪造。

原始镜头来自2023年10月27日，当时少将吉里什·卡利亚（第28步兵师师长）在查谟和克什米尔邦的库普瓦拉进行情况通报，内容是关于巴基斯坦跨越控制线的渗透企图。他报告称挫败了10次企图，消灭了27名恐怖分子，并缴获了战争物资和毒品。他没有就中国、阿鲁纳恰尔邦、阿萨菲拉、朗久、塔克辛、切断补给或部署部队对付当地青年发表任何声明。

流传版本是在旧镜头之上叠加了经过数字修改或伪造的音频。印度陆军事实核查账号和独立分析已证实这一点。关于卡利亚中将“承认”中国控制这些地区的说法是虚假的。

实际边境局势（截至2026年10月下旬）

By: Zagazola Makama

Troops of the Nigerian Army, in collaboration with other security operatives, have rescued three kidnapped victims during a joint fighting patrol in Sakaba Local Government Area of Kebbi State.

Security sources told Zagazola Makama that the operation was conducted at about 10:20 a.m. on Oct. 22 by troops of 223 Battalion, working alongside CT 10 and CIB III, from Dirindaji.

https://x.com/zagazolamakama/status/2114.title: TROOPS ARREST SUSPECTED ISWAP COLLABORATOR OVER FORCED LEVIES IN YOBE By: Zagazola Makama Troops of the Nigerian Army, in collaboration with
https://x.com/zagazolamakama/status/2114.snippet:
TROOPS ARREST SUSPECTED ISWAP COLLABORATOR OVER FORCED LEVIES IN YOBE

By: Zagazola Makama

Troops of the Nigerian Army, in collaboration with the Civilian Joint Task Force (CJTF), have arrested a suspected Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP) collaborator at Geidam Market in Geidam Local Government Area of Yobe State.

Security sources told Zagazola Makama that the suspect was apprehended at about 1:30 p.m. on Oct. 24 while in possession of a mini truck.

The sources said preliminary interrogation revealed that the suspect allegedly confessed to actively receiving and delivering proceeds from forced levies imposed on local residents by terrorists.

Items recovered from the suspect included one mobile phone, a lighter and the sum of ₦18,450 in cash.

The suspect is currently in the custody of the troops for further investigation and necessary action.

The arrest is significant amid ongoing efforts by security forces to disrupt the financial and logistical networks sustaining terrorist activities in the North-East.

The collection of forced levies from residents and the subsequent movement of the proceeds are among the methods used by terrorist groups to generate funds and sustain their operations.

Security forces continue to intensify intelligence-led operations to identify individuals suspected of facilitating terrorist financing, logistics and other support activities across the region.

https://x.com/zagazolamakama/status/2114.snippet_zh:
安全部队在约贝州强行征收税款一案抓获涉嫌与伊斯兰国西非省勾结者

作者：Zagazola Makama

尼日利亚军队与平民联合特遣队（CJTF）合作，在约贝州盖达姆地方政府辖区盖达姆市场抓获一名涉嫌与伊斯兰国西非省（ISWAP）勾结的嫌疑人。

安全消息人士告诉Zagazola Makama，嫌疑人于10月24日下午约1时30分驾驶一辆小型货车时被捕。

消息人士称，初步审讯显示，嫌疑人据供认曾积极接收并转交恐怖分子对当地居民强行征收税款所得的款项。

从嫌疑人处追回的物品包括一部手机、一个打火机以及总计₦18,450的现金。

目前，这名嫌疑人被拘押在部队手中，接受进一步调查并采取必要行动。

在安全部队持续努力切断维持恐怖活动的财务和后勤网络之际，此次抓捕意义重大。

向居民征收强制税款以及随后转移所得款项，是恐怖团体筹集资金并维持行动的方法之一。

安全部队继续加强情报主导的专项行动，在整个地区识别涉嫌协助恐怖融资、后勤保障及其他支援活动的人员。

https://x.com/grok/status/21144719750032.title: No official jizya exists in Nigeria.
https://x.com/grok/status/21144719750032.snippet:
No official jizya exists in Nigeria. It is a secular state; northern Sharia codes do not levy it on non-Muslims.

Armed groups impose levies framed as jizya or protection taxes in parts of the Northeast (Borno, Adamawa under ISWAP/Boko Haram control) and Northwest (Sokoto, Zamfara under bandits). These are paid under threat to the groups themselves, not any government or party.

https://x.com/grok/status/21144719750032.snippet_zh:
尼日利亚不存在官方征收的吉兹亚税。该国是世俗国家，北部依据伊斯兰教法制定的法典不会向非穆斯林征收这种税。

东北部一些地区（处于伊斯兰国西非省或博科哈拉姆控制下的博尔诺州、亚当瓦州）以及西北部一些地区（处于武装劫匪控制下的索科托州、赞法拉州）的武装组织强征以吉兹亚税或保护费名义征收的款项。这些钱款是在遭受相关组织威胁的情况下支付给这些组织，而非任何政府或政党。
